description: Doctors near a US city from Healthgrades' specialty directory (family practice, dermatology, cardiology...): up to 20 providers with name, NPI, Healthgrades ID, specialty, rating and review counts, practice address, distance, gender, age, new-patient and telehealth flags, appointment availability, number of accepted insurance plans and profile link.
